The animal with distinctive black and white stripes is the zebra.

Semantic role analysis of the sentence: "The firefighter raced into the burning building to rescue the trapped occupants, demonstrating true heroism."

Main Verb: raced

- The firefighter: Agent (the one performing the action)
- into the burning building: Location/Goal (where the action is directed)
- to rescue the trapped occupants: Purpose (why the action was performed)
- demonstrating true heroism: Manner/Result (accompanying action or result of the main action)
